hypotheses.title: Non-Templated Multi-Dataset Orthogonal Alpha Breakout
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Break free of repetitive price-reversal formula templates and eliminate self-correlation bottlenecks by harvesting three radically independent market structures: (1) Supply Chain Lead-Lag Momentum (pv13): Information diffuses slowly across inter-firm customer-supplier networks. Customer return shocks propagate to supplier revenues with a 5-day decay lag. (2) Options Put Breakeven Safety Margin (option9): Stocks trading well above open-interest weighted put breakeven levels have institutional support, while stocks nearing the floor face dealer gamma selling. (3) Institutional Volume-Return Rolling Correlation (pv1): Stocks exhibiting positive rolling correlation between daily returns and trading volume reflect sustained institutional accumulation rather than speculative noise.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if customer return signals are immediately priced in or if put breakeven levels are disregarded during market drawdowns.
